# How to Sync Task with Claude MCP and Medux

Learn how to use Claude MCP and Medux to sync the task with the upstream provider and return the latest local state, including setup, request fields, tool…

## Expected Medux tools

- `medux_task_query`

## Prompt

```text
Use Medux to check the task {task id} with medux_task_query and report its status. If it has succeeded, give me the output URL.
```

## Review before approval

- `task_id` (required): Public task id returned by a Medux tool call.

## Claude notes

- In claude.ai or Claude Desktop, attach inputs and enable the Medux connector for the conversation.
- In Claude Code, keep inputs in the working directory and confirm Medux with `/mcp`.
- An attachment is not a Medux `file_id`; approve the upload step when the workflow requires one.
